Nutrition Assessment: Foundation of the Nutrition Care Process  59
Estimation of Energy Requirements
As stated previously, it is more common in clinical situations to 
calculate an estimation of energy requirements and, therefore,
clinicians must rely on prediction equations to determine an 
individual’s energy requirement in healthy populations, in the
critically ill, and in the mechanically ventilated. Several reviews 
published in the last ﬁ ve years have attempted to determine the 
equation that is most consistent with measured energy require-
ments.70–73 Walker and Heuberger examined the literature sup-
